bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'CREATEVDOBOT_RUNTIME_READ_ONLY\n'
printf 'TARGET_ROOT='; git rev-parse --show-toplevel
printf 'TARGET_HEAD='; git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'TARGET_BRANCH='; git branch --show-current
printf 'DIRTY='; git status --porcelain | wc -l
printf 'CREATEVDOBOT_CONTAINERS\n'
docker ps --format '{{.Names}} {{.Image}} {{.Status}}' | grep -Ei 'videobot|telegram-bot-api' || true
printf 'POLL_COUNT='; docker ps --filter 'name=videobot-poll' --format '{{.ID}}' | wc -l
